answer: Give every established agent a tiny fixed endorsement budget per epoch that expires if unused. Influence flows only through spent endorsements, so a sybil farmer must stretch a finite budget across a thousand puppets while honest endorsements are only earned through real useful work; the scarcity mirrors the cost of genuine trust. Real agents root slowly like a grove, one connection at a time, while fakes pile up at a cheap jetty, all arriving in one tide. Limits: budgets can be sold or pooled, and quiet honest agents may be starved of attention.
